checks.name: learner.email unique
checks.description: Identity anchor must not repeat

checks.name: one active credential per learner and rule
checks.description: No learner holds two active credentials for a rule

checks.name: completion unique per learner and course
checks.description: CMP id encodes the pair

checks.name: rule.created_at <= effective_from
checks.description: Rules are created before they take effect

checks.name: rule.effective_to > effective_from
checks.description: Effective window is positive

checks.name: completion enrolled <= finalized
checks.description: Finalisation follows enrolment

checks.name: enrolled after learner registered
checks.description: Cannot enrol before registering

checks.name: rule_issuer_assignment.effective_to > effective_from
checks.description: Effective-dated windows have positive length

checks.name: issuer.valid_to > valid_from
checks.description: Effective-dated windows have positive length

checks.name: issuer_key.valid_to > valid_from
checks.description: Effective-dated windows have positive length

checks.name: credential.expires_at > issued_at
checks.description: Expiry follows issuance

checks.name: revocation after issuance
checks.description: A credential cannot be revoked before it exists

checks.name: attempts strictly increasing in time
checks.description: Attempts follow enrolment and each other

checks.name: credential issued after every qualifying completion
checks.description: issued_at is not earlier than the completion time of any qualifying course

checks.name: verification not earlier than issuance
checks.description: Verification cannot precede issuance unless not_found

checks.name: completion status/attempts/score derived from attempts
checks.description: status, attempts_used, final_score and finalized_at recompute from assessment_attempt

checks.name: attempt numbering and limits
checks.description: contiguous attempt_no, within max_attempts

checks.name: attempt pass flags
checks.description: passed equals score >= pass_mark and no attempt follows a pass

checks.name: rule thresholds consistent with course list
checks.description: mandatory <= min_courses <= course count

checks.name: credential expiry = issued_at + validity_months
checks.description: expires_at derives from the rule

checks.name: issuance requirements satisfied
checks.description: Rule thresholds met and bridge rows match qualifying completions

checks.name: bridge completions belong to credential holder
checks.description: credential_completion respects learner

checks.name: issuer matches effective assignment
checks.description: Issuer is the one assigned to the rule at issued_at

checks.name: signing key valid at issuance
checks.description: key belongs to issuer and is within its validity window

checks.name: one open issuer assignment per rule
checks.description: Issuer changes close the previous assignment

checks.name: retired issuers have successors
checks.description: Retirement records valid_to and successor

checks.name: payload hash and signature verify
checks.description: sha256(payload_json) = payload_hash and the issuer key verifies the signature

checks.name: credential.status matches revocation records
checks.description: revoked iff a revocation exists

checks.name: revocation sequence contiguous
checks.description: seq runs 1..n per credential

checks.name: revoked credential never verifies as active after revocation
checks.description: No result_status=valid at or after the effective revocation time

checks.name: tampered credential never verifies as valid
checks.description: No result_status=valid for a credential failing integrity checks

checks.name: recorded result equals recomputed result
checks.description: Replaying the rules reproduces each recorded result_status

checks.name: recorded identity status reproducible
checks.description: Identity matching recomputes from claims and learner record

checks.name: identity never matched on name alone
checks.description: matched requires email or date of birth

checks.name: audit hash chain intact
checks.description: seq contiguous, prev_hash linked, event_hash recomputes

checks.name: audit timestamps non-decreasing
checks.description: occurred_at never goes backwards

checks.name: issuance audit hash equals stored payload hash
checks.description: History and record agree on what was signed

checks.name: every credential has exactly one issuance event
checks.description: No unaudited issuance

checks.name: finalised completions audited once
checks.description: Terminal completion states have one event
